'''Sandpipes''' were used by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] as a method for keeping [[Time/Legends|time]]. They were held in the [[Kesh capitol building]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tahv]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], and were in use during [[Time of the Rot|The Time of the Rot]], which began about [[3960 BBY]].
